text.tspan: Share living in extreme poverty vs exports as share in GDP
Extreme poverty is defined as living below the International Poverty Line of $1.90 per day.
Total trade in goods and services as a share of GDP
Source: World Bank PIP and OECD
Note: Poverty data relates to household income or expenditure, measured in international-$ at 2011 prices to account for inflation and differences
in the cost of living between countries.
